bull_case: Sustained double-digit revenue/VAS growth and buybacks can push realized FCF/share toward the Bull path.
bear_case: A regulatory shock or slower cross-border/volume growth can compress both earnings and the multiple.
thesis: Visa is a high-quality business at a full but not prohibitive valuation. The current price is about 12% above locked Base value, so upside depends on executing at or above a healthy long-run FCF/share path.

evidence.claim: FY2025 owner-style FCF proxy was about $20.68B.
9M FY2026 owner-style FCF proxy was about $14.44B.

counterevidence: Regulatory and interchange litigation can pressure network economics and pricing over time.
The current valuation already embeds a high-quality compounder profile.
unknowns: Long-run regulation of interchange and routing
Sustainable growth rate of Visa Direct and value-added services
falsifiers: If processed transactions and payments volume decelerate materially while client incentives rise faster than gross revenue, the moat/FCF thesis weakens.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is above Base but well below Bull; it does not require an unrealistic Bull+ case.

next_checks: Payments volume, cross-border volume, processed transactions, value-added services, client incentives, owner FCF/share, buyback price
